title: SPA/78/2025 of ANAMIKA MISHRA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:

1
I N THE HI GH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAI NI TAL
THE HON'BLE CHI EF JUSTI CE MR. G. NARENDAR
AND
THE HON'BLE JUSTI CE MR. ALOK MAHRA
SPA No. 78 of 2025
6th May, 2025
Anamika Mishra --Appellant
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Others --Respondents
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-
Mr. Sandeep Adhikari, learned legal aid counsel for the appellant.
Mr. J. S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State.
----------------------------------------------------------------------
JUDGMENT : ( per Mr . G. Nar en dar C.J.)

Perused the delay condonation application (IA
No.1 of 2025), and the grounds urged in support of the
application. Being satisfied with the cause shown, delay
of 30 days in preferring the instant appeal is condoned,
and the delay condonation application is allowed.
2. Appellant has prepared a supplem entary
affidavit. On the previous date of hearing, this Court,
while on the verge of dismissing the appeal, gave an

2025:UHC:3536-DB
2
opportunity to the appellant to redeem herself. Today, an
application is filed, whereby the appellant has offered
her sincere apologies and has deposed in para nos.4 and
5 as under: -
"4. That it is pertinent to mention here that the order passed by this
Hon'ble Court is not reflected in writing in the order dated 28-04-2025,
although the applicant/petitioner in compliance of the order of this
Hon'ble Court has already prepared a Demand Draft in the name of
"High Court Legal Services Committee" which is being filed herewith
and marked as ANNEXUE No. 1 to this supplementary affidavit.
5. That the Hon'ble Court has also directed the applicant/petitioner to
tender her apology in writing. In compliance of the order of this
Hon'ble Court the present applicant/petitioner offering her sincere
apologies to the esteemed court for filing continuous writ petition on
the wrong legal advice. I fully recognize the importance of maintaining
the dignity and integrity of the judicial process, and I deeply regret my
actions that may have disrupted or disrespected the court's
proceedings.
 I acknowledge that my conduct was inappropriate (by filing
continuous writ petition on the wrong legal advice), and I understand
the significance of the rules and responsibilities that govern the
behavior expected in such a respected institution. I take full
responsibility for my actions and realize that they were not in
accordance with the high standards upheld by this court.
 Please know that I have learned a valuable lesson from this
experience, and I am committed to ensuring that such an incident does
not happen again. I deeply respect the work of the court and the
significant role it plays in maintaining justice, and I hope my actions do
not undermine the trust placed in me."
3. The dem and draft for a sum of Rs.50,000/ - is
also produced. In view of the fact that the appellant is a
lady and has expressed her apologies and there is also
offer to voluntarily pay the cost quantified at

2025:UHC:3536-DB
3
Rs.50,000/ -, we deem it appropriate to allow the appeal,
insofar as, the aspect of the cost alone is concerned.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the unconditional
apology tendered by the appellant is taken on record
and the amount of cost im posed of Rs. 1 lakh is m odified
and the sam e is quantified at Rs. 50,000/ -.
4. The dem and draft, bearing no.824499 drawn
by the Punjab National Bank, Branch Nehru Colony,
Dehradun dated 02.05.2025, for a sum of Rs.50,000/ -
be deposited in the account of Uttarakhand State Legal
Services Authority. The original of the dem and draft is
handed over to the Court Master. The Court Master shall
handover the sam e to the Mem ber Secretary, State
Legal Services Authority.
 ( G. NARENDAR, C.J.)

( ALOK MAHRA, J.)
Dated: 06.05.2025
